roles.label: Brunswick Salaried Employee (U.S. & E.U.)
roles.description: Audience of the optional employee awareness eLearning (~10 min, Workday Learning), per the SOW audience segmentation.

roles.label: Brunswick People Manager
roles.description: Audience of the required core eLearning (~30–40 min); the most common channel for communicating pay program information to employees (EOC deck, Foundation for Pay Transparency).

roles.label: Brunswick HR
roles.description: Required core eLearning audience alongside managers; local partner for consistent application of pay practices.

roles.label: Compensation & Benefits team (Enterprise HR)
roles.description: Conducts compensation reviews, benchmarking, calibration, and role analyses at the enterprise level (Manager's Guide, Shaping Pay Programs).

roles.label: Pay Transparency EHRC team
roles.description: Facilitates the optional instructor-led sessions and owns the pay-transparency initiative (SOW; EOC update).
